categories.title: Categories to anonymise
categories.cyberHelp: Credentials and technical identifiers (IP and MAC addresses, password hashes, keys, certificates, wallets, host names, IMEI and serial numbers): recognised by format, no model involved.

terms.globalHelp: Every occurrence of the text (case-insensitive, whole words) is replaced by a placeholder with the tag you choose. An existing tag continues its own numbering alongside whatever the model finds.
terms.globalHelpScope: These apply to everyone: no user can remove them, and anyone can add their own under “My terms”.
terms.textHelp: The word or phrase to always anonymize wherever it appears, e.g. the company name or a person's first and last name. The text is case-insensitive.
terms.tagHelp: The category of the placeholder that replaces the text. For example, for the company name you could write CUSTOM_ORG: the document will show CUSTOM_ORG_1.
